semantic_test_specifications.expected: Reject duplicate stage_id even when object values differ; JSON Schema uniqueItems alone cannot detect this.
Downgrade all intersecting proposals before publication; never assign one Stage twice.
Reject self-reported RESOLVED with missing source object; cross-file lookup required.
Reject a listed covered alert with no actual purpose witness; do not trust counts.
Two members joined only through an excluded Stage remain disconnected.
Reject directed endpoints or A_TO_B/B_TO_A that differ from original accepted decision.
Projection set must equal original accepted relation IDs exactly, including unassigned endpoints and internal edges.
Reject true flags when byte hashes, source membership, or recomputed counts disagree.
